item.title: Two giant dams starved the Danube Delta of sediment for decades
item.description: The Danube's sediment supply to its delta has significantly decreased due to upstream engineering works. Large dams like the Iron Gates trap sediment, altering the natural balance of the delta. This reduction in material has led to increased coastal erosion along the delta's seaward edge. item.title: Scientists find water was fueling volcanoes 3 billion years ago
item.description: Ancient rocks from Western Australia suggest water was reaching deep inside Earth more than three billion years ago, long before modern plate tectonics may have fully developed.
